signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the roadmap: translate already-defined business objectives and priorities into a roadmap the engineering and design teams can execute, sequencing what matters now versus later.
Partner cross-functionally: work with the Tech Lead to shape features from an engineering standpoint, and with UX/UI to define how they should be designed.
Drive execution: work with the Project Manager to break the roadmap into trackable sub-items and keep delivery on schedule.
Be accountable, out loud: commit to concrete deliverables — a weekly status report, a decision by a set date — and deliver on them consistently.
Lead client demos: run product demos with prospective clients and communicate clearly the value.
